item.title: MDC Offers Virtual Class On Deer Hunting Regulations
item.description: Deer Hunters are invited to learn Missouri’s Deer Hunting regulations in a January 1st virtual program. item.title: Candidate Filing Continues For April Election
item.description: Filing for the April Municipal Election continues through December 30th. For the Central Dispatch Board, Kathy Tuttle filed for the West District seat with a 4 year term. That filing takes place the the Livingston County Clerk’s office.

item.title: Two Crashes With Serious Injuries In Clinton County
item.description: A two-vehicle crash left both drivers with serious injuries Sunday evening. State Troopers responded to the crash at 7:40 pm on Missouri 116, at NE Valann Lane, near Lathrop. item.title: Caldwell County Jail Booking
item.description: A Breckenridge man was booked into the Caldwell County Detention Center by Caldwell County Deputies on Saturday. Thirty-five-year-old Clay Eugene Kiser was booked at about 2:50 am for alleged Peace Disturbance. His bond is set at $500, cash only. He has an initial appearance in Caldwell County Court on Thursday.
